about: An error ends the block it was raised in (W3C SCXML 4.9): an integer operation that overflows skips its statement, raises error.execution, and nothing after it in the block runs — whether it stood in the block itself, in the condition of an <if>, or in a branch of one. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: 250 + 10 does not fit a uint8: the assignment is skipped and the one after it does not run
the condition overflows, so it is false and the <else> runs; the <if> raised, so the block ends after it
the overflow is inside a branch: the branch and the block that contains the <if> both end
nothing fails, so the block runs to its end
